mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Latest procurement lots (most recently published, newest first)
Full procurement lot register (bulk browse, list-level fields)
Detail lookup (specific lot ID(s) -- quantities, price, specs, milestones)
mode.description: 'latest' returns the most recently published procurement plan lots across all agencies. 'list' paginates the full register (29,000+ records) -- optionally scoped to one fiscal year. 'detail' fetches item-level detail for one or more specific lot IDs.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Applies to 'latest' and 'list' modes. Records are fetched 50 at a time -- e.g. 200 fetches 4 pages.

fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal year ID (optional)
fiscalYearId.description: Optional. Restricts 'latest'/'list' to one Ethiopian fiscal year (July 8 - July 7), by its internal ID. Example: "00535025-fa1b-4ec8-a69e-1622639235ff" is the current fiscal year (ET-FY-2019, i.e. Gregorian 2026-07-08 to 2027-07-07). Leave blank to include all fiscal years.

lotIds.title: Procurement lot IDs
lotIds.description: Mode 'detail' only. Lot ID(s) from the 'id' field of a 'latest'/'list' record, e.g. "29208ca2-a834-4bb5-80cf-95d2dc62a057".

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: Mode 'detail' only -- how many lot lookups to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Off by default -- no WAF/CAPTCHA was found on this target (confirmed across multiple TLS/browser profiles), so a direct connection works reliably.
